subject.title: feat(message): list chat / list messages should support pagination instead of hardcoded 25 limit

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared message-action pagination cursor/page-token contract for read, search, pins, and chat/channel list results, or treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99089 as the final scope for this issue?
rationale: The observable formatter bug is fixed on main, but the remaining work changes the public action result shape and provider contracts rather than applying a narrow mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Define Shared Cursor Contract
options.body: Add a provider-neutral pagination response shape, wire supported providers through it, and keep unsupported providers explicit about one-page limits.

options.title: Split Provider Follow-ups
options.body: Close the shared contract discussion after opening narrower provider-specific issues for Discord search and Teams history/list surfaces.

options.title: Stop At Formatter Fix
options.body: Document that the CLI only shows one provider page and close the remaining cursor iteration request as out of current scope.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Cursor Contract
recommendation.body: Add a provider-neutral pagination response shape, wire supported providers through it, and keep unsupported providers explicit about one-page limits.

likelyOwner.reason: This account made the latest maintainer-visible product-scope call by reopening the issue after the partial fix merged.
